title: Fix cross-volume chapter numbering to use count-based offset with normalized local numbers
description: Change _compute_chapter_offset in BOTH app_service.py and stream_service.py to use len() (count of chapters) instead of max(chapter_numbers). Also normalize chapter numbering in create_chapters_from_detailed_outline and _create_chapter_records to use sequential 1-based local numbers. This prevents double-counting when structure_json contains global numbers from the LLM prompt.

files.change: 1. _compute_chapter_offset (L660): change max() to len(). 2. create_chapters_from_detailed_outline (L752-763): sort chapters_raw by raw number, enumerate with 1-based index, use index as local_number for global_number = offset + index

1. _compute_chapter_offset (L134): change max() to len(). 2. _create_chapter_records (L466-473): sort chapters by raw number, enumerate with 1-based index, use index as local_number for number = chapter_offset + index

criteria: Volume 1 with 6 chapters gets #1-#6; Volume 2 chapters start at #7 (no gap)
Works regardless of what numbers the LLM puts in structure_json
Both app_service.py and stream_service.py paths produce consistent numbering
